Step 6 - GPS Location (survey point - record before moving on)
Primary: Google Maps -> tap blue dot -> record the complete coordinates shown.  Fallback: NCIL -> MAP tab -> record LAT/LON exactly as displayed.  Do not round the values. Latitude negative e.g. -9.4318123. Longitude positive e.g. 160.0523456.
Step 7 - Tower NCIL Readings, GPS and Photo Evidence
When to complete Step 7: Only if you can walk to within 10 metres of the tower base safely and without trespassing. If the tower is behind a fence, on private land, or on a slope you cannot safely reach, select Accessible: No and explain the reason.
Complete this in the same order used in the field: first record the NCIL RAW tab readings and screenshot, then record the NCIL MAP/GPS coordinates and screenshot, then upload photos of the tower structure.
Auto-filled from login. Change this if someone else collected the tower reading and you are only uploading it.
1. NCIL RAW tab readings
Open NCIL RAW tab at or near the tower. Record the serving LTE block values exactly as shown, then upload the RAW screenshot for verification.
Required for cross-checking MCC/MNC, eNB, ECI, PCI, TAC, LTE band, RSRP, RSRQ and RSSNR/SINR entered above.
2. NCIL MAP tab GPS coordinates
Open NCIL MAP tab or Google Maps at the tower base. Record the GPS coordinates separately from participant survey points, then upload the GPS/map screenshot.
3. Tower structure photo and access notes
Record the physical tower type, whether the structure was safely accessible, and upload a photo of the tower structure for evidence.
